title: Make some art with your phone sensors
originalTitle: Make some art with your phone sensors
content:
tilt motion mic cam net sound

ink brush ground — Mbps — motion

tilt moves the pen — vertical position picks a violin note (pentatonic, snapped). sound input sets brush size and bow pressure (volume + brightness). camera sets ink color and the violin's tone (warm hues = darker, cool = brighter). connection speed tints the background and sets reverb size — slow & cavernous, fast & dry. Touch the canvas to override the pen.

Needs https:// or localhost. Tap "Begin" and grant motion + microphone + camera. iOS asks once. Speed test pulls 512 KB from Cloudflare every 15 seconds.
